tests.name: (d) pointercancel mid-drag ends the gesture without inertia or a stuck press
is idempotent and stops further camera writes

items.gap: jsdom has no `PointerEvent`: the test dispatches `new MouseEvent("pointercancel", {bubbles, cancelable, clientX, clientY})` with `pointerId`/`pointerType`/`timeStamp` defined onto it, on the engine's overlay element. A real browser `pointercancel` (e.g. the OS taking over a touch) is therefore modelled, not reproduced.

Nothing under `lib/chart-engine/` sets `touch-action` or `overscroll-behaviour` (`grep -rn "touch-action\|touchAction\|overscroll" lib/chart-engine/` returns no matches at HEAD), and no test dispatches a touch that starts inside the chart while an ancestor scrolls. KINETIC's synthetic events are `bubbles: true, cancelable: true` and only the wheel path asserts `defaultPrevented`, so a scrolling ancestor's behaviour is unproven either way.
